subscriptions.content:
proxies:
  - name: awg-example
    type: wireguard
    server: server.example.com
    port: 51820
    ip: 10.0.0.2
    private-key: <client private key>
    public-key: <server public key>
    pre-shared-key: <psk, optional>
    mtu: 1408
    udp: true
    persistent-keepalive: 25
    ip-stack:
      mode: mips
      congestion-controller: bbr3
    remote-dns-resolve: true
    dns:
      - 1.1.1.1
    allowed-ips:
      - 0.0.0.0/0
      - ::/0
    amnezia-wg-option:
      # Only version 3 selects the v3 implementation. Other values use legacy.
      # version: 3
      jc: 4
      jmin: 40
      jmax: 70
      s1: 50
      s2: 100
      # s3/s4 require AmneziaWG 1.5+. With header-protection-key all s1-s4 must be >= 12.
      s3: 0
      s4: 0
      # h1-h4 accept one number or a "start-end" range in AmneziaWG 2.0+.
      h1: 1
      h2: 2
      h3: 3
      h4: 4
      i1: <hex>
      i2: <hex>
      i3: <hex>
      i4: <hex>
      i5: <hex>
      # AmneziaWG 1.5 only; removed in 2.0+. Do not combine with version: 3.
      # j1: 0
      # j2: 0
      # j3: 0
      # itime: 0
      # AmneziaWG 3.0 only. Each value is a number or an "a-b" range.
      # header-protection-key: <base64 key>
      # content-padding-addition: "0-64"
      # rekey-after-time: "100-140"
      # rekey-timeout: "4-6"
      # reject-after-time: "160-200"
      # keepalive-timeout: "8-12"
      # max-handshake-attempts: "16-20"
      # AmneziaWG 3.1 only.
      # random-trailers: true
      # disable-cookies: true

proxies:
  - name: openvpn-example
    type: openvpn
    server: vpn.example.com
    port: 1194
    proto: udp
    username: <username>
    password: <password>
    udp: true
    dev: tun
    data-ciphers:
      - AES-256-GCM
      - AES-128-GCM
    data-ciphers-fallback: AES-256-CBC
    auth: SHA512
    ping: 10
    ping-restart: 60
    ip-stack:
      mode: mips
      congestion-controller: bbr3
    ca: |
      -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
      <CA cert here>
      -----END CERTIFICATE-----
    tls-crypt: |
      -----BEGIN OpenVPN Static key V1-----
      <static key here>
      -----END OpenVPN Static key V1-----
    # Use only one of tls-auth, tls-crypt, or tls-crypt-v2.
    # tls-auth: |
    #   -----BEGIN OpenVPN Static key V1-----
    #   <static key here>
    #   -----END OpenVPN Static key V1-----
    # key-direction: "1"
    # tls-crypt-v2: |
    #   -----BEGIN OpenVPN tls-crypt-v2 client key-----
    #   <client key here>
    #   -----END OpenVPN tls-crypt-v2 client key-----
